mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO trace_conversation (conversation_id, trace_id, user_id, source, agent_id, agent_name, start_ts, end_ts, duration_ms, status, error_message, event_count, token_input, token_output, model, environment) VALUES
(#{item.conversationId}, #{item.traceId}, #{item.userId}, #{item.source}, #{item.agentId}, #{item.agentName}, toDateTime(#{item.startTs,typeHandler=com.agentscopea2a.mapper.ck.typehandler.ClickHouseTimestampTypeHandler}, 'Asia/Shanghai'), toDateTime(#{item.endTs,typeHandler=com.agentscopea2a.mapper.ck.typehandler.ClickHouseTimestampTypeHandler}, 'Asia/Shanghai'), #{item.durationMs}, #{item.status}, #{item.errorMessage}, #{item.eventCount}, #{item.tokenInput}, #{item.tokenOutput}, #{item.model}, #{item.environment})

INSERT INTO trace_event (event_id, conversation_id, trace_id, event_type, event_name, source, timestamp, duration_ms, event_json) VALUES
(#{item.event_id}, #{item.conversation_id}, #{item.trace_id}, #{item.event_type}, #{item.event_name}, #{item.source}, toDateTime(#{item.timestamp,typeHandler=com.agentscopea2a.mapper.ck.typehandler.ClickHouseTimestampTypeHandler}, 'Asia/Shanghai'), #{item.duration_ms}, #{item.event_json})
mapper.select: SELECT conversation_id, trace_id, user_id, source, agent_id, agent_name, start_ts, end_ts, duration_ms, status, error_message, event_count, token_input, token_output, model, environment FROM trace_conversation WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY end_ts DESC, trace_id DESC, start_ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT event_json FROM trace_event WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY timestamp ASC, parseDateTime64BestEffortOrNull(JSONExtractString(event_json, 'createdAt'), 9, 'UTC') ASC, event_id ASC
